items.q: And a guy came in and did this write up. Jim Bell, James Bell did the write up.

ctx.x: When I had just got back from Europe, the War rather and we were playing at a place called 'The Brass Rail' in Chicago on Randolph and Dedborn. And a guy came in and did this write up. Jim Bell, James Bell did the write up.
